purpose: Extend the observation record past v1.3's 2010-12-31 end with daily group counts from KMAS and SWPC, over their full span so the pre-2010 overlap calibrates them against the existing observer network.
threshold_convention: a group counts when its area is strictly greater than the threshold
single_use_rule: KMAS is also a reference survey in reference_groups_2026-10/. Its counts are derivable from its areas, so any run must declare KMAS's role as reference areas OR observer counts, never both. SWPC has no such constraint.
data_lineage: Sunspot-survey observations only (Kislovodsk KMAS and NOAA/SWPC Solar Region Summary), processed by sunspot-homogenization at the pinned commit and reduced here to daily group counts above a set of acuity thresholds. No isotope, aurora, proxy or SILSO sunspot-number input anywhere in this lineage (ADR-002 firewall).
